Bonus Domain.description: Upon reaching 1st level, the warpriest receives an additional domain: Glory if he turns undead, or Domination if he rebukes undead.

Fear Aura.description: Starting at 5th level, the warpriest can project a frightening aura once per day. This aura extends in a 20-foot radius and lasts for 1 round per warpriest level. Enemies within the area must succeed on a Will save (DC 10 + warpriest class level + Charisma modifier) or suffer the effects of a fear spell.

Haste.description: Upon reaching 7th level, the warpriest gains the ability to use haste as a spell-like ability three times per day.

Heroes' Feast.description: Once per day, a warpriest of 6th level or higher can use heroes' feast as a spell-like ability.

Implacable Foe.description: At 10th level, the warpriest can channel positive or negative energy to sustain his allies through otherwise fatal injuries. Activating this power requires a move action, and the warpriest must concentrate each subsequent round to maintain it. While active, the warpriest radiates a 100-foot aura. Allies within this area can ignore the effects of being at 0 or fewer hit points; however, any creature reduced to -20 hit points or below dies instantly. Once the effect ceases or an ally moves beyond the 100-foot radius, the full effects of any accumulated damage take hold immediately. If the warpriest normally turns undead, this ability benefits living allies; if he normally rebukes undead, it benefits undead allies instead.

Inflame.description: By spending a full-round action, the warpriest can stir the resolve of his companions. Every creature that can hear him receives a morale bonus on saving throws against charm and fear effects. This bonus starts at +2 at 2nd level and grows by +2 at every subsequent even-numbered level (+4 at 4th, +6 at 6th, and so on). The effect persists for 5 minutes after the warpriest finishes speaking, plus an additional 1 minute per warpriest level. The warpriest himself also benefits from this bonus.

Mass Cure Light Wounds.description: Beginning at 3rd level, the warpriest can use mass cure light wounds once per day as a spell-like ability. His caster level for this effect equals his highest divine caster level.

Mass Heal.description: At 9th level or higher, the warpriest can use mass heal once per day as a spell-like ability. His caster level for this effect equals his highest divine caster level.

Rally.description: As a standard action, a warpriest who is not currently affected by any fear effect can bolster his allies. Each ally within 60 feet who can hear the warpriest and is suffering from a fear effect receives an additional saving throw against that effect, gaining a +1 morale bonus to the roll for each warpriest class level.

Spells per Day/Spells Known.description: The warpriest's divine spellcasting continues to advance as he gains levels. At every even-numbered warpriest level (2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th, and 10th), the character receives new divine spells per day (and spells known, where applicable) as though he had gained an additional level in a divine spellcasting class he possessed prior to entering this prestige class. No other class benefits from that earlier class are gained, such as improved undead turning or more frequent use of remove disease. A character who had multiple divine spellcasting classes before becoming a warpriest must choose which class benefits from the spellcasting advancement each time he reaches an even-numbered warpriest level.

Turn or Rebuke Undead.description: Warpriest levels stack with the character's cleric or paladin levels for the purpose of turning or rebuking undead.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: A warpriest is proficient with every simple and martial weapon, all armor categories (light, medium, and heavy), and all shields, tower shields included.
